story_head: How a holiday campaign raised $3.4M in five weeks
story: h
A New Donation Strategy

Prior to partnering with Adtaxi, after decades of traditional fundraising, the nonprofit was struggling to drive repeat donations and engage new donors for a holiday campaign. One of the pain points they faced in the past was proving to new donors that their donation is directly affecting the field.

The nonprofit asked Adtaxi to create an effective donation strategy for their holiday campaign within a strict deadline. We tapped into dynamic creative optimization, which is vital in this digital age where data and insights can be harnessed effectively by an organization looking to boost conversion rates. Adtaxi leveraged programmatic, taking advantage of social display ads within the programmatic environment not only to engage audiences but also to generate donations. Adtaxi’s digital strategy successfully bestowed trust in new donors by applying reassurance language in the ad copy, CTA buttons, and videos.

The nonprofit has not historically focused on driving donations through digital means, but after decades of traditional fundraising, the switch to digital advertising resulted in historic funds raised. While the Q4 campaign ran for only 39 days, Adtaxi was able to produce extraordinary donation results in a short time span.
h
Start with Research

Adtaxi created and managed the digital marketing strategy for the nonprofit’s holiday campaign, first engaging in in-depth market research using Scarborough and IAB services among the different sources.
Once our research was able to hone in on the 1-3 distinctive personas, we started creating those audiences via a data management platform.
h
Connect with Key Audiences

Adtaxi created strategic audience segmentation using both 1st and 3rd-party sources to reach hyper-relevant individuals in an effort to generate donations with a true omnichannel approach across display, pre-roll video, FB/IG, and Google.
The flight period of the campaign was short (the last week of November and December), but Adtaxi worked to create urgency in the ad copy as well as message continuity between the channels.

We were able to successfully nurture our prospecting audience from being completely unfamiliar and unaware of the nonprofit to donating through a strategic “funnel” approach. Messaging evolved as we moved users through the TOF-MOF-BOF.
Strong use of remarketing around 1st party past donors, site visitors, and donation abandoners allowed Adtaxi to really target the nonprofit’s “core audience.”
h
Build Awareness
Aside from the return on ad spend measurement Adtaxi created an internal brand impact by reminding the organization’s local leaders about the initiative.

Adtaxi’s campaign created a donation movement online and offline, to encourage people to give. On the social front, we used dynamic creative optimization to collect data and insight on what type of creative has a higher tendency for conversion. We then implemented our learning into the programmatic realm by creating banners and pre-roll videos with continuity messaging.

One of the pain points the nonprofit faced in the past was proving to new donors that their donation is directly affecting the field. Adtaxi utilized reassurance language in our ad copy, CTA buttons, and videos to bestow trust in new donors.

Within programmatic, Adtaxi encouraged repeat donations by retargeting previous donors again after 21 days from their previous donation. Additionally, Adtaxi utilized social display ads within programmatic to engage users, leading to 262 donations at a $29.90 ROAS in December.
h
Measurable Results

For the very first time in the nonprofit’s history, Adtaxi was able to achieve tangible results getting positive ROAS for Q4 directly attributed to our campaigns, only 30 days from launch. Using clear strategic thinking, research and insights, innovation and creativity, tangible results and outcomes, proof of effectiveness, organizational impact, and measurement combined led to X1.6 ROAS for November and X18 for December.
Overall, in a 5-week span, Adtaxi was able to help this nonprofit raise over $3.4M.
